_comment: Owned by the audio task. All prompts and lines are original wording, not imitating any BattleTech or MechWarrior sound or voice. Run `npx tsx tools/gen-audio.ts` to generate missing files into public/audio/<id>.mp3 (music into public/audio/music/<id>.mp3, opt-in with --kind=music). Mirrored by src/client/audio/manifest.ts.

items.prompt: One loud, close-up footfall of a light, nimble walking war machine: a punchy metal servo thud of a small steel foot on gravel with a short hydraulic whine, mid-range clank with strong presence, no music, no voices
One footfall of a medium walking war machine: a solid metallic thump of a heavy steel foot on packed earth, a short hydraulic hiss and a faint creak of armor plates, no music, no voices

One loud, close-up footfall of a heavy walking war machine: a punchy, powerful mid-range steel clang and thud of a huge steel foot with a hydraulic hiss and rattling armor, strong presence, no music, no voices
One loud, close-up footfall of a colossal assault walking war machine: a massive steel stomp with a punchy metallic impact, a hydraulic hiss and grinding gears, strong presence, no music, no voices
A mechanical servo whine as a giant machine torso rotates on its waist ring: rising then falling electric motor pitch with a gear grind and a soft metal clunk at the end, no music, no voices
Jump jets igniting on a giant machine: a sharp percussive whump of ignition, then a rising hiss of rocket exhaust that fades in the last third, with dynamics, no music, no voices
Sustained rocket jump-jet thrust of a giant machine in flight: steady heavy roaring exhaust with a hot rushing hiss, no music, no voices
A giant walking machine landing after a jump: a heavy double metal impact, a puff of exhaust hiss and settling armor rattle, no music, no voices
A huge walking war machine falling over: a groan of tearing metal, then a massive crash of armor on the ground with scraping and clattering debris, no music, no voices
A fallen giant machine pushing itself upright: straining hydraulic motors, grinding joints, scraping metal and a final heavy thud of both feet planting, no music, no voices
A small laser: a thin high-pitched electric zap, a quick sizzling beam burst. Single sharp report, fast attack, no music, no voices
A medium laser: a loud, clean mid-pitched energy beam burst with a bright electric sizzle and a short decay. Single sharp report, fast attack, full volume, no music, no voices
A large laser: a deep powerful beam discharge, a rising charge-up whine then a thick searing blast with a lingering sizzle, no music, no voices
An extended-range laser: a sharp crackling energy beam, high bright electrical crackle with a tight cutting edge. Single sharp report, fast attack, no music, no voices
A pulse laser: a rapid stutter of five to six fast energy zaps in a burst, like a staccato electric chatter, no music, no voices
A heavy laser: a very deep thrumming beam, a heavy low pulsing throb with a thick searing tail, no music, no voices
An X-pulse laser: a fast crackling triple pulse of erratic bright energy zaps with a harsh electric buzz, no music, no voices
A particle projector cannon: a charging whine then a violent crackling thunderclap discharge of a bolt of blue lightning with a booming tail, no music, no voices
A light particle cannon: a short snapping electric discharge, a sharp crack of lightning with a quick whine, no music, no voices
A heavy autocannon firing one round: a deep punching cannon report with a metallic bolt clack and a short rolling echo. Single sharp report, fast attack, no music, no voices
A shotgun-style cannon blast: one huge booming muzzle blast followed by a wide hissing rain of scattering pellets, no music, no voices
An ultra autocannon firing a double report: two heavy cannon shots in very fast succession, bang-bang, with brass clack. Single sharp report, fast attack, no music, no voices
A rotary autocannon: a roaring spinning barrel assembly firing a continuous fast stream of heavy rounds, a mechanical chainsaw-like roar, no music, no voices
A small compact autocannon: a quick light snapping cannon report, a fast double bark with a metallic ping. Single sharp report, fast attack, no music, no voices
A gauss rifle: a rising electric capacitor charge whine, then a single violent supersonic magnetic slug crack with a deep thud, no music, no voices

A long-range missile launch: a sharp percussive thump of the first rocket leaving the rack, then a rapid ripple of rockets whooshing away with hissing motors that fades, strong fast attack, no music, no voices
A short-range missile launch: a quick sharp whoosh of two to six rockets leaving a launcher with a fast hiss and a thump, no music, no voices
A multi-missile launcher: a medium whoosh of a rapid burst of rockets leaving a tube, hiss and thump with a slight rattle, no music, no voices
A cluster of missiles impacting on armor: a rapid series of sharp small explosions popping one after another with metal ringing and debris, no music, no voices
A machine gun: a fast rattling burst of small-caliber rounds, tight staccato mechanical rattle. Single sharp report, fast attack, no music, no voices
A giant machine punch: a heavy metal fist swinging through air then smashing into armor plating with a dull boom and ring, no music, no voices
A giant machine kick: a hydraulic swing whoosh and a heavy steel foot slamming into armor with a deep crunching thud, no music, no voices
A huge war machine charging into another: a fast rush then a massive collision of tons of metal with a shuddering crash and screeching scrape, no music, no voices
A death from above leap: a short descending whistle then one sharp catastrophic crushing metal impact with a single shockwave boom and a fast decay, strong transient attack, no music, no voices
A weapon hit on armor plating: a loud metallic clang with a ringing resonance and small sparks scattering, no music, no voices
Internal structure damage on a giant machine: a deep crunching tearing of metal beams, snapping girders and a dull crack, no music, no voices
A critical hit alarm stab: one sharp metallic crunch impact, a brief silence, then a short single electronic buzzer blip, with dynamic contrast, no music, no voices
A limb torn off a giant machine: a violent wrenching shriek of metal, a loud snap and the heavy limb crashing to the ground with clatter, no music, no voices
An ammunition store detonating inside a machine: a sharp thunderous chain of explosions, popping rounds cooking off and a heavy boom with metal fragments, no music, no voices
A fusion engine breach: a deep rumble, a sharp crackle of shorting energy, a bursting hiss of escaping plasma and a descending power-fail drone, no music, no voices
A giant war machine destroyed: a huge fiery explosion with a booming blast, then cascading metal debris, wreckage crashing and fire crackling, no music, no voices
Cockpit damage: a burst of electrical sparks and crackling short circuits with a glass crack and a metallic rattle, no music, no voices
An original heat warning alarm: a repeating two-tone electronic beep-beep alert, pitched urgent and steady, clean synthesized tones, no music, no voices
A giant machine reactor shutting down: a descending power-down whine falling in pitch, fans spinning down, a final heavy clunk of dying systems, no music, no voices
A giant machine reactor starting up: a rising power-up whine, relays clicking, fans spinning up and a final low hum settling, no music, no voices
Coolant venting from a machine: a long steady hiss of pressurised coolant gas escaping with a soft metal rattle at the start, no music, no voices
A single crisp mechanical button click, a short dry tactile switch snap, no music, no voices
Two wooden dice rattling and rolling across a hard table and settling, short tumbling clatter, no music, no voices
A single clear brass bell strike with a ringing metallic decay, a soft ceremonial chime, no music, no voices
